fusions.name: Tightening Noose
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 30% health. Drops a loop over a target up to 5 tiles away and draws it shut. It deals 20 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full range, and leaves the target [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Wire Bars Closing
fusions.desc: Draws a ring of wire bars shut around you. It deals 28 damage that ignores armour to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaves them [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Cradle of Strands
fusions.desc: After a 0.5 second cast, holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Last Lattice
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 35%, strands close around you as a shield worth 20% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
